question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, and Eve are playing a game. At the start of the game, they are each holding a ball: Alice has a red ball, Bob has a black ball, Claire has a white ball, Dave has a purple ball, and Eve has a gold ball.
As the game progresses, pairs of players trade balls. First, Claire and Dave swap balls. Then, Dave and Eve swap balls. Then, Alice and Bob swap balls. Then, Claire and Eve swap balls. Finally, Dave and Claire swap balls. At the end of the game, Dave has the
Options:
(A) red ball
(B) black ball
(C) white ball
(D) purple ball
(E) gold ball
solution:
Ball colors in order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve):
Initial: (red, black, white, purple, gold)
1. Claire and Dave swap: (red, black, purple, white, gold)
2. Dave and Eve swap: (red, black, purple, gold, white)
3. Alice and Bob swap: (black, red, purple, gold, white)
4. Claire and Eve swap: (black, red, white, gold, purple)
5. Dave and Claire swap: (black, red, gold, white, purple)
Dave has the white ball, option (C).
Final answer: (C)
